key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3364
name: traverse_index_chain_to_target
description: Walks a chain of records linked by next-index bytes, starting from the byte at offset 15 of the given structure and stepping through 34-byte entries of a global table. It returns the record just before the target entry, or the last record before the end marker 255.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3396
name: copy_and_swap_link_bytes
description: Stores a byte from the source record into the destination record, then moves a link byte between the destination and the first record. The field offsets used are 15 or 14 depending on whether the source is the first record itself.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:33CA
name: move_link_byte_and_reset
description: Sets a marker byte in the destination record to 255, copies its link byte into a field of the first record at offset 15 or 14 depending on whether the source is that record, and then resets the destination link byte to 255.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:33F6
name: check_and_relink_matching_entry
description: Reads a tag byte from offset 19 of the structure, finds its predecessor in the chain, and compares that predecessor's link byte with the tag. On a match it relinks the entry through two list routines and returns the comparison result.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3464
name: recurse_then_relink_entry
description: Calls the entry routine on the given record when its marker byte at offset 32 is not 255, then looks up a related record and passes the pair to the relink routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:34AA
name: relink_entry_if_tag_matches
description: When the index byte at offset 32 is valid, finds the matching table record and compares the appropriate link byte with the tag at offset 19 of the structure. It relinks the entry only when the two bytes agree.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:34FC
name: call_routine_if_tags_equal
description: Compares the byte at offset 14 of one register-supplied structure with the byte at offset 19 of another, and calls a follow-up routine only when the two bytes are equal.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3508
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3510
name: call_entry_then_mark_done
description: Calls the handler on the global table record chosen by the upper 16 bits of the second argument, passing the structure. It then sets the byte at offset 7 of the structure to 255 and returns one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3562
name: find_and_dispatch_list_entry
description: Selects a list head from a byte in the structure and walks its nodes, comparing each 16-bit key with the supplied key. On a match it calls the routine on the record that node refers to and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3588
name: dispatch_matching_list_node
description: Walks a linked list from the register-supplied head. When a node's 16-bit key equals the key in another register, it calls the routine on the table record that node refers to and returns minus one, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:35AC
name: dispatch_list_node_after_head
description: Advances from the head to the following node first, then on the first node whose 16-bit key matches it calls the routine on the table record that node refers to and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:35C2
name: copy_table_record_into_struct
description: Copies two 16-bit fields and one byte from a global table record, selected by the upper half of the second argument, into the structure. It sets the low bit of a flags byte from a table flag, calls the handler on the structure and returns minus one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3610
name: process_entry_if_key_found
description: Looks up the list head chosen by a byte at offset 19 of the structure and searches its nodes for the supplied 16-bit key. If a node matches it calls the routine on the structure and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3654
name: find_node_and_call_routine
description: Walks a singly linked list from the register-supplied head looking for a node whose 16-bit key equals the key in another register. When one is found it calls the follow-up routine and returns one, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3664
name: search_list_then_process_entry
description: Searches the list head chosen by a byte at offset 19 of the structure for a node whose 16-bit key matches. On success it calls the routine on the structure and returns one, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:36A2
name: find_node_and_call_handler
description: Walks a singly linked list from the register-supplied head for a node whose 16-bit key matches the key in another register. When found it calls the follow-up routine and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:36B2
name: check_record_byte_matches
description: Returns one when the record index held in a global byte is valid and the second byte of the argument equals the byte at offset 24 of that 32-byte global table record. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:36E2
name: initialize_list_nodes_and_records
description: Links 255 consecutive 12-byte list nodes so that each points to the next, with the final link cleared. It then marks the key field of each global record up to a stored count with 65535 and clears a global counter.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3730
name: find_key_index_in_array
description: Scans the global pointer array up to its recorded count for an entry whose stored 16-bit key equals the low word of the argument. It returns that entry's zero-based position, or minus one if no entry matches.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3776
name: rebucket_record_by_grid_key
description: Computes a grid key from the record's two position words and, when it has changed, removes the record from its old bucket and returns freed nodes to a pool. It then inserts the record into the bucket for the new key and sets change flags on linked records.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:39EC
name: queue_record_update_request
description: Marks a global table record as pending and, for records of certain state types when the request level is low, takes a node from a free pool. The node stores the record, its index and the level, and is then linked into the list for that slot.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3A40
name: stub_infinite_loop
description: After unreachable blocks are removed, the decompiled body reduces to an empty infinite loop, so the routine never returns. The reachable code shows no real work.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3CA6
name: read_entry_and_check_code
description: Handles text entry into a six-slot buffer: code 9 removes the last character and printable characters are appended. On Return it compares the buffer, XORed with 215, against a stored six-byte string and counts failed attempts.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3CC4
name: read_keypress_into_buffer
description: Reads the next character from a key translation table into a six-slot text buffer. Code 9 removes the last character, printable characters are appended and the buffer is redrawn with a cursor; Escape clears it and Return is passed on to the checking code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3CF6
name: append_key_to_buffer
description: Stores a typed character in a six-slot text buffer while it is not full, then redraws the buffer with an underscore cursor and reads the next key from a translation table. Return triggers the six-byte comparison of the entry against a stored table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3D3C
name: verify_entry_and_copy_record
description: Compares the six-byte entry with a stored table after XOR with 215. On mismatch it counts a failed attempt, and on match it copies the table record's fields into the matching slot, updates its flags and list position, and returns minus one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3D9A
name: count_failed_attempt_and_halt
description: Clears a flag and increments a failure counter. Below three failures it updates two display words and loops forever; at the third it writes a return instruction code into a code word and returns one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3DD0
name: queue_record_update_node
description: Sets a pending-update count and a value from the record's state when it is of a certain type and the request level is low. It then takes a node from a free pool and stores the record, the slot index and the level in it.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3E54
name: reset_counter_and_link_node
description: Resets the pending counter to 25 and copies a value into its companion slot. When the free pool is not empty it takes a node and links it into the list for the given slot.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3F2A
name: next_pseudo_random_word
description: Advances a 32-bit pseudo-random state by doubling it and, on overflow or a zero result, applying a fixed feedback constant. It returns the low 16 bits of the new state.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:3FE8
name: find_longest_window_match
description: Searches up to 2048 bytes of earlier data for the longest repeat of the bytes at the current position, keeping the best offset and length in globals. It returns one when no useful match is found, otherwise it passes the match to the output routines and returns its code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:400E
name: find_longest_match_in_range
description: Searches a bounded range of earlier data for the longest repeat of the current bytes, recording the best offset and length. It returns one when no useful match is found, otherwise it passes the match on to the output routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4046
name: find_match_by_length_table
description: Searches earlier data for repeats of the current bytes and keeps the longest candidate by comparing it against a per-length table. It then passes the match to routines and returns one or a packed result code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:40B2
name: pack_bits_into_longwords
description: Converts a count into a bit sequence by shifting bits from a source value into a bit accumulator, storing each completed 32-bit group at the destination pointer. A zero count returns at once, and small and large counts use different base values.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:40CC
name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:40CE
name: increment_and_pack_length_bits
description: Increments a global counter, then forms a value from the argument minus nine with its upper bits set. It shifts the bits of that value into 32-bit words at the destination and returns when the bit count runs out.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:40DE
name: shift_merge_bits_to_longs
description: Merges bits from one 32-bit source into a bit accumulator, one bit at a time. It writes each completed 32-bit word to the destination pointer and stops when the bit count runs out.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:418E
name: lookup_grid_cell_value
description: Returns a cell value from a 16-by-16 grid selected by a byte stored in the structure. It applies global x and y offsets, negates the y offset when a mirror flag is set, and returns one when the position falls outside the grid.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:419A
name: lookup_grid_cell_from_registers
description: Performs the same grid cell lookup as its sibling routine, with the coordinates supplied in registers rather than a parameter block. It returns one when the position falls outside the grid.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:41DE
name: read_grid_cell_byte
description: Returns the byte stored at a grid position computed from a row, a column and a block index. The layout uses 16-byte rows and 112-byte blocks inside the global data.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4202
name: lookup_wrapped_cell_value
description: Returns a grid cell value for a column and row supplied in registers. A row out of range wraps into the neighbouring block, and positions outside the grid return one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4240
name: lookup_cell_in_row_range
description: Returns a grid cell value for a row and column supplied in registers. Rows above or below the block switch to the neighbouring block, and positions outside the grid return one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4280
name: lookup_lower_block_cell
description: Returns a grid cell value for a row of seven or more, using the register inputs. The row wraps into the neighbouring block below, and positions outside the grid return one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:42C0
name: read_block_cell_byte
description: Returns the byte at a row and column inside a block of the global grid, with the block chosen by a byte in the structure. It uses 16-byte rows and 112-byte blocks.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:42EC
name: save_mark_cells_as_one
description: Marks a span of grid cells with the value 1 for a visible block. If a saved span already starts at the same address it reuses that record; otherwise it stores the previous cell bytes in a new node and then writes the marks.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4300
name: save_mark_cells_as_two
description: Marks a span of grid cells with the value 2 for a visible block. It reuses a saved span that starts at the same address, or stores the previous cell bytes in a new node before writing.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4314
name: save_and_clear_cell_span
description: Clears a span of grid cells to zero for a visible block. It reuses a saved span at the same address, or stores the previous cell bytes in a new node before clearing.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:43C0
name: write_value_to_cell_span
description: Searches the saved span list for a matching start address. When a match is found it writes the given value across the span; otherwise it saves the current bytes in a new node if space remains and then writes the value. It returns one in both cases.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4422
name: restore_saved_cell_span
description: Finds the saved span whose start address matches a cell address computed from the structure. It then copies the saved bytes back into the cell span.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:44C0
name: copy_table_record_and_relink
description: Copies two words and a byte from one global table record to another chosen by an index, then calls the handler on the structure. When the owning lists match it updates the flags and recomputes the copied record's position by walking the list.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:45C6
name: check_index_lists_for_conflict
description: Walks the index lists starting from the structure's index word. It returns zero when a neighbouring record of a particular type carries a different tag byte, and minus one when the lists show no conflict.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:45DE
name: check_all_lists_for_conflict
description: Scans every index list in turn, starting from the index held in a register. It returns zero when a neighbouring record of a particular type carries a different tag byte, and minus one when no list remains.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:45FC
name: advance_list_until_conflict
description: Steps through the current index list and advances to the next list when it ends. It returns zero on the first neighbouring record of a particular type with a different tag byte, and minus one when no lists remain.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4628
name: scan_remaining_lists_for_conflict
description: Continues the scan of the index lists from the current node, checking neighbouring records for a particular type with a different tag byte. It returns zero on a conflict and minus one when the lists are exhausted.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4650
name: find_record_value_by_tag
description: Walks a chain of records from a global head byte and finds the first record whose tag at offset 24 matches the high byte of the second argument. It returns that record's value at offset 33 on a match, or 255 when no record matches.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4668
name: find_chain_record_by_tag
description: Walks a chain of records starting from a register-supplied index and returns the byte at offset 19 of the first record whose tag matches a register byte. It returns 255 when the chain ends without a match.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:468A
name: walk_record_chain_for_tag
description: Walks a chain of records from a register-supplied record pointer and returns the byte at offset 19 of the first record whose tag matches. It returns 255 when the chain ends without a match.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:46AC
name: stub_unconditional_recursion
description: Makes three unconditional calls to itself with no base case, so it never terminates as written. The pseudo-code is a decompiler stub for an unreachable target and is not real game logic.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:46C8
name: check_list_contains_key
description: Searches the list headed by the index byte at offset 19 of the structure for a node whose 16-bit key equals the supplied key. It returns one when such a node is found and zero otherwise.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4706
name: call_handler_for_list_key
description: Searches the list headed by the index byte at offset 19 of the structure for a node whose 16-bit key matches. On a match it calls the handler with the node's stored word and returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4724
name: find_node_call_stored_word
description: Walks a singly linked list from the register-supplied head for a node whose 16-bit key matches. On a match it calls the handler with the node's stored word and returns one, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:474E
name: check_list_has_type_flag
description: Scans the list headed by the index byte at offset 19 of the structure. When the supplied key is zero it returns one if any node has type one or two; otherwise it returns one if any node has type three or four, and zero when neither is found.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4776
name: list_has_type_one_two
description: Walks a list from the register-supplied head and returns one when any node holds the type value 1 or 2, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4798
name: list_has_type_three_four
description: Walks a list from the register-supplied head and returns one when any node holds the type value 3 or 4, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:47B6
name: stub_return_zero
description: Routine consisting only of a return of zero, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:47BA
name: check_list_for_pair_match
description: Searches the list headed by the index byte at offset 19 of the structure for a node whose 16-bit key matches the first value. The node's key must also equal an entry of a small table in the structure selected by the second value, and it returns one on a match.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:47F0
name: find_node_matching_both_keys
description: Walks a list from the register-supplied head and returns one when a node's key equals both of two register values, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:480C
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns the constant zero to the caller without any other effect.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:48F8
name: call_handler_with_record_byte
description: If the index byte at offset 15 of the structure is not 255, calls the handler with the byte at offset 17 of the global table record that index selects. It always returns one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4930
name: call_handler_along_record_chain
description: Walks a chain of records from the structure and calls the handler with the byte at offset 19 of each record. It stops when the next link byte at offset 14 is minus one, and returns one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:493C
name: call_handler_for_chain_records
description: Walks a chain of records from the register-supplied record and calls the handler with the byte at offset 19 of each one. It stops when the link byte at offset 14 is minus one, and returns one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:49B4
name: decrement_counter_compare_key
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 10 of the structure. It returns minus one when the counter equals the supplied key, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:49CA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Routine that returns the constant zero with no calls, memory access or other effect.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:49F0
name: set_flag_store_record_head
description: Looks up a record index in a small table using the key argument, but only for keys below four. When the index is valid it sets flag bit 2 on that global record and stores the record's address in the matching slot of the global pointer array. It always returns one.

name: step_until_accepted_with_range

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:4D52
name: add_offset_along_record_chain

name: update_word_table_low_byte

description: Walks the list headed by the structure's index word and reads the 16-bit value at offset 10 of each node that belongs to the structure or passes a type test. It returns the last value taken, or the structure's own index when none was taken.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:503A
name: find_next_record_of_type
description: Walks the list after the current node and returns the first record whose type byte at offset 18 matches the register byte, skipping the structure's own record. When the type is minus one it returns the first record found.

name: check_marker_past_column_threshold
description: Returns minus one when the record's marker byte equals the global marker and its position lies beyond a column threshold, or when the marker's table entry equals the global marker. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5086
name: compare_marker_via_table
description: Returns minus one when the marker byte at offset 7 of the structure is valid and its table entry equals the marker byte of the second structure. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:50A8
name: check_marker_column_below_threshold
description: Returns minus one when the record's marker byte equals the global marker and its column position is below a threshold, or when the marker's table entry equals the global marker. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: compare_marker_via_table_regs
description: Returns minus one when the marker byte of the register structure is valid and its table entry equals the marker byte of the second structure. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: check_position_gap_below_limit
description: Returns minus one when the position word of the second structure is less than that of the first and their difference is below the supplied limit. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: check_marker_matches_table_entry
description: When the supplied key is zero and the marker byte of the first structure is valid, returns minus one if the second structure's marker equals the global table entry for that marker. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:51BC
name: compare_marker_with_slot_192
description: Returns minus one when the second structure's marker byte equals the byte at offset 192 of the first structure, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:51CA
name: check_marker_same_band_side
description: Returns minus one when the record's marker byte matches the global marker and it lies in the same column band as a reference position, on the side set by a direction flag and offset. It also returns minus one when the marker's table entry matches, and otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5218
name: check_first_position_less
description: Returns minus one when the position word of the first structure is less than that of the second, otherwise zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5228
name: check_gap_within_limit_reversed
description: Returns minus one when the difference between the second and first position words, taken in a direction set by a global flag, is positive and less than the supplied limit shifted left four bits. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:0:5240
name: check_position_gap_forward_limit
description: Returns minus one when the first position word is less than the second and the difference is below the supplied raw limit. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: check_marker_table_entry_match
